**Observation Log:**

- [FACT] The user wants assistance as a UX/UI developer for a digital product.
- [EVENT] The user requested to create a loyalty app UI.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant expressed willingness to help with the loyalty app UI.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant suggested focusing on simple and clear navigation for the app.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant recommended a minimalist design to avoid visual clutter.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant emphasized the importance of a personalized user experience in the loyalty app.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant proposed adding gamification elements to increase user engagement.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant advised making reward redemption easy for users.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant suggested incorporating social sharing features into the app.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant recommended testing and iterating on the app design based on user feedback.
- [USER] The user requested guidance on selecting a prototyping tool for the loyalty app.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant selected Figma as the prototyping tool for the loyalty app.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant instructed the user to set up a Figma account at figma.com.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant guided the user to create artboards for each screen of the loyalty app in Figma.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant advised adding UI elements such as buttons, text, icons, and images to the artboards.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant explained how to add interactions between screens using Figma's "Prototype" mode.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant instructed the user on how to create a functional prototype by linking screens together.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant suggested testing the prototype with friends or colleagues for feedback.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant mentioned that Figma allows real-time collaboration, which can be beneficial for team projects.
